theme: Minnesota moose and wetland browsing: a long-legged calf with velvet buds grows broad leaf-veined palmate antlers, a heavy shoulder hump and splayed bog hooves. The adult uses its living antler palms to part reeds and shelter feeding calves; no weather effects or trees planted on its body.
habitat: Northern willow shores, shallow ponds and soft wetland margins.

sources.evidence: Long legs, splayed hooves, palmate antlers, throat bell and aquatic-plant browsing.
sources.fantasy_extension: All powers, anatomy changes and discovery scenes are original fiction.
